name: Gorakhpur
scopeLimits: The ranked UN World Urbanization Prospects 2025 population-weighted locator is not a municipal boundary or parcel identity. Official local/state property or cadastral services were identified, but no point-specific public parcel polygon was verified. No full geometry is retained.
pointBasis: UN WUP 2025 population-weighted settlement centroid; this is not a municipal boundary or a parcel-coverage claim.
registryBasis: Official Gorakhpur district land-records service directs users to Uttar Pradesh’s official land-record system; the state Board of Revenue documents revenue-village maps, khasra, and plot-boundary records. The district Bhulekh dashboard provides Gorakhpur-specific village map/georeferencing coverage statistics. The point is a city settlement locator, and the dashboard is district/tehsil-wide rather than point-specific.
technicalBlocker: The official BhuNaksha shell is not evidence of this locator’s urban/revenue-village map. Correct village extent/point identification could not be resolved anonymously; previous two-level map-info attempt failed at an upstream GIS-code endpoint.
remainingUncertainty: Whether the WUP city point lies inside a georeferenced Gorakhpur revenue village or a distinct urban cadastral map; whether the public BhuNaksha geometry service covers the exact locality.
nextStep: Resolve the exact selected revenue village or official urban GIS map for the WUP point, then make a bounded geometry-only query if an anonymous endpoint is available.

viewerAndServiceTrace.summary: The official viewer shell was inspected. Its initial extent is Agra. A two-level Gorakhpur Sadar map-info attempt failed because the upstream GIS-code creation route returned HTTP 403/500; no confirmed village was selected and no valid parcel response was obtained. The district dashboard’s aggregate georeferencing counts are not evidence of coverage at the ranked urban point.
